Whether your child loves stories, solving mysteries, or simply exploring the world around them, this adventure will spark their imagination while you share meaningful time together outdoors! You walk to real locations in your city by following clues and once there, you will solve fun puzzles together and unlock new chapters

rows.activity_name: Hobbledown Heath London s Largest Adventure Playground
rows.age_suitability: all ages welcome Description Looking for a way to treat the little ones for a day? Hobbledown Heath is London's largest indoor and outdoor adventure playground, with four villages set in picturesque woodland, where kids can climb towers, crawl through tunnels, and safely explore an expansive play area! With a mini farm featuring goats, alpacas, meerkats, lemurs, and plenty more exotic and traditional animals, this is the ultimate day out that's sure to create lasting memories for the whole family
